queries: CoreWeave S-1 2025 2024 revenue net loss 863 1.9 billion sec

sources_considered.why: The original registration statement exceeded the reader's file-size limit.
Readable company-hosted filing containing audited 2024 comparative revenue and customer concentration. Only its 2024 figures are used.

evidence_items.locator: Business overview; consolidated statements of operations, page 87; Customer Concentration, page 95
evidence_items.explanation: The filing's tables report 2024 revenue of $1,915 million and customer shares of 62% and 15%, implying approximately $440 million from the remaining customers. This confirms the numerical premise but does not settle whether that amount was commercially adequate for the scale discussed.

metric_scope.metric: Revenue excluding the two largest customers

inputs: 2024 revenue: $1,915 million, consolidated statements of operations.
2024 largest customer share: 62%, Customer Concentration table.
2024 second-largest customer share: 15%, Customer Concentration table.
derived.rounding: Approximately $440 million; customer percentages are rounded, so $440.45 million is not an exact disclosed residual.

unresolved_gaps: The financial figures establish substantial absolute sales but do not establish the contextual standard of commercial adequacy.
No verified utilization or customer-level demand evidence was obtained for the residual customer group.
No comparison establishes whether those sales were sufficient for the operating scale invoked in the post.
